ns2:course.label: Scientific Writing: Proposals, Manuscripts, and Peer Review
ns2:course.description: Advanced writing course covering topics specific to scientific writing, with emphasis on proposals, manuscripts, and peer review. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Any 599 credit (sufficient data or research results for at least one figure or table).
